patterns.name: Cervical Prevertebral Fascia Oscillation Pattern
patterns.frontend_language: prevertebral-visceral fascial oscillatory dysfunction with GB/SI axis dominance
triggers: SP-overload with phlegm and Qi reversal (descending mental overdrive)
symptoms: somatisation of directional conflict ('cannot turn away / cannot speak truth')
patterns.anatomical_basis: Pharyngeal arch (embryological origin: mesoderm + neural crest) → transforms into prevertebral and visceral fascia layers. This fascia connects skull base ↔ neck ↔ mediastinum ↔ diaphragm ↔ retroperitoneum. It is a vertical resonance channel, not a discrete anatomical boundary. The stellate ganglion sits embedded in prevertebral fascial layers between longus colli and longus capitis — it is a sensor, not the primary cause.

C2_C3.clinical: hoarseness, globus, occipital-retroauricular tension, headache, dizziness
C2_C3.channel_logic: GB = which direction; SI = can it be spoken

C5_C6.clinical: shoulder tension, arm radiation, lower dysphagia component, voice fatigue
C5_C6.channel_logic: GB = I would change direction; SI = but I am told I cannot

pathological_directions.ascending: visceral pressure from abdomen/thorax rises via prevertebral fascia → cervical symptoms (Wen Dan Tang pattern)
pathological_directions.descending: SP overload, phlegm, mental rumination → Qi reversal ascending counterflow → vagal irritation, globus, upper mediastinal symptoms

interventions.formula_logic: 1 base + 1 direction + 1 guide herb — if more needed, axis is wrong

TCM.name: Wen Dan Tang (base — always)
TCM.role: phlegm resolution, reverse-flow, vagal oscillation dampening

TCM.name: Xiao Chai Hu Tang direction (if GB dominance)
Qing Hao or Yin Chen Hao (if hidden heat / GB stagnation)
TCM.notes: Select if stagnant heat pattern present

interventions.device: low-level laser — static hold, low energy, target: longus colli / prevertebral projection — NOT sweeping, NOT destructive — vibration reset only
contraindications: aggressive cervical manipulation is contraindicated when: active dysphagia or hoarseness, unstable autonomic symptoms (dizziness, palpitation), strong scapular rebound was previously triggered, symptoms change with speech or breathing
stellate ganglion block is contraindicated when: symptom does not resolve with directional change; phlegm/SP overload dominant; cervical symptoms worsen with visceral triggers

rules.condition: cervical_symptoms AND (hoarseness OR globus OR dysphagia OR shoulder_tension)
rules.action: assign CERV_PREVRT; do NOT treat as structural cervical pathology alone; assess direction (ascending vs descending); apply 1-base + 1-direction + 1-guide formula logic
theme = suppressed truth; primary guide = Jie Geng (LU); primary direction = Xiao Chai Hu Tang
theme = identity vs obligation; primary guide = Hou Po (ST); primary direction = Xiao Chai Hu Tang

rules.condition: stellate_ganglion_block considered AND (phlegm_dominant == true OR visceral_trigger_worsens == true)
rules.action: contra-indicate SGB; use Wen Dan Tang + laser prevertebral axis instead
